response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer (13+ years) with strong distributed-systems, low-latency, and event-driven work, plus solid testing/craftsmanship and mentoring credentials. However, the role is fundamentally a C++ platform engineering position in industrial automation, and his hands-on C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project — C++ does not even appear in his listed skills. He also lacks the required secure-development-lifecycle/IEC 62443 background, MQTT/industrial protocol experience, and Azure exposure. His profile is that of a TypeScript/Node/D full-stack engineer, which is a poor match for the core technical competencies despite strong general engineering signals.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency, event-driven distributed systems
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, tooling authorship, mentoring and public teaching
Broad polyglot range across backend, embedded-adjacent, and full-stack work
concerns: Minimal recent C++/STL experience; C++ absent from listed skill set
No SDL, IEC 62443, or industrial cybersecurity background
No MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, IoT, or industrial automation domain exposure

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation / security standards domain gap
